Consider the following functions:

$f(x) = \sqrt{-x + 3}, g(x) = (x + 2)^{2} - 1$

By filling the empty cells in the table below, determine which option gives the best approximate solution of the equation $f(x) = g(x)$.

| $x$ | $-3.9$ | $-3.8$ | $-3.7$ | $-3.6$ | $-3.5$ |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| $f(x)$ |  | $2.61$ | $2.59$ | $2.57$ |  |
| $g(x)$ |  | $2.24$ | $1.89$ | $1.56$ |  |
| $f(x) - g(x)$ |  | $0.37$ | $0.70$ | $1.01$ |  |
| $\mid f(x) - g(x) \mid$ |  | $0.37$ | $0.70$ | $1.01$ |  |

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.
